tldr: Mercury in Capricorn: the mind is strategic, serious, and oriented toward results.
body: With Mercury in Capricorn, communication becomes structured, practical, and focused on what can be built. You think in timelines, consequences, and usable plans.
gift: Strategy, professionalism, concise speech, and long-range planning.
challenge: Pessimism, rigidity, or withholding words until warmth disappears.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
